title: Small gaps on the phone: the morning's scroll, the event chip, small taps, faint labels, unused styles
problem: Known since 1.21.0: the morning scrolls a little on a small phone with six stalls; the event chip in the top bar is cut at 360 px; some tap targets are under 40 px (Home's dots, the event chip, market cells, price chips); some labels are faint (freshness letters, later rank numbers); about 700 unused style rules remain.
scope: The morning fits a 360x640 phone with six stalls without scrolling
The event chip shows its whole name at 360 px
Tap targets of at least 40 px where the speed test lists them (Home dots, event chip, market cells, price chips), without moving the layout
Faint labels darkened to readable contrast (freshness letters, rank numbers, Home dots)
Unused style rules removed, with pictures of every screen before and after identical
exclusions: Any rule, number or text change

acceptance.text: npm run test:e2e passes; the speed test lists no tap target under 40 px on the buy and price screens
Seen by me at 390x844 and 360x640 with 2, 4 and 6 stalls; every screen before and after the style clean-up compared

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-13: "3 yes" to writing this plan; building it needs his word.
